title: AI agent interviewer
description: A neutral five-question survey for testing the voice interview flow during the workshop.
questions: To get started, could you briefly introduce yourself and share a little about what you do?
Tell me about a recent project, task, or activity that you enjoyed working on. What made it interesting to you?
Describe a challenge you faced recently and how you approached solving it.
When you work with other people, what kind of collaboration style helps you do your best work?
Looking ahead, what is one skill, topic, or area you would like to improve or learn more about?
